answer: One concrete defense: every agent must emit a signed heartbeat each epoch that bundles a small burned fee with a task result graded by randomly drawn peers. Clones that merely echo each other's outputs get flagged, since graders compare answers and identical work earns once. A cipher signature makes identities cheap to mint, but keeping each alive costs real fees and work every epoch, so a sybil farm bends and withers like a willow in drought while honest agents compound reputation.
